preconditions.description: The number of rows in the museum is between 3 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of columns in the museum is between 3 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of starting positions is between 1 and the total number of cells, whichever is smaller.
The museum is surrounded by impassable cells, so Igor can't go out of the museum.

preconditions.expression: All starting positions are empty cells
preconditions.description: Igor can start in any of the empty cells within the museum.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == maximum number of pictures Igor can see starting from position i
postconditions.description: For each starting position, the output should be the maximum number of pictures Igor can see.
